record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.context_brief: LCLT and ASIP for equilibrium states
record.original_question: For μ_φ as in Problem 4, show that every Hölder continuous observable that is not a coboundary satisfies the local central limit theorem and the almost sure invariance principle.

evidence.quote: Problem 7. — Let µϕ as in Problem 4. Show that all Hölder continuous observables which are not coboundaries satisfy the LCLT and the ASIP with respect to µϕ.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f: \mathbb{C}^2 \to \mathbb{C}^2$ be a complex Hénon map, i.e., a finite composition of generalized Hénon maps of the form $(x,y) \mapsto (y, p(y) - a x)$ with $p$ a polynomial of degree at least $2$ and $a \in \mathbb{C}^*$. Let $J^*$ be the support of the unique measure of maximal entropy, and more generally let $\phi: J^* \to \mathbb{R}$ be a Hölder continuous potential within the class for which a unique equilibrium state $\mu_\phi$ (a $(f,\phi)$-invariant Borel probability measure maximizing $h_\nu(f) + \int \phi \, d\nu$ over $f$-invariant Borel probability measures on $J^*$) is known to exist, to be mixing, and to have exponential decay of correlations for Hölder observables.

For any real-valued Hölder continuous observable $\psi: J^* \to \mathbb{R}$ that is not a coboundary (i.e., there is no measurable $u$ with $\psi = u \circ f - u$ $\mu_\phi$-a.e.), prove the following two statistical limit laws with respect to $\mu_\phi$:

(a) Local Central Limit Theorem (LCLT): writing $S_n \psi = \sum_{k=0}^{n-1} \psi \circ f^k - n \int \psi \, d\mu_\phi$, there exists $\sigma > 0$ such that for every bounded interval $I \subset \mathbb{R}$,
$$\lim_{n \to \infty} \sup_{s \in \mathbb{R}} \left| \sigma \sqrt{n}\, \mu_\phi\{ S_n \psi - s \in I \} - \frac{|I|}{\sqrt{2\pi}} e^{-s^2/(2 n \sigma^2)} \right| = 0.$$

(b) Almost Sure Invariance Principle (ASIP): on some probability space one can construct a sequence of random variables distributed as $(S_n \psi)_n$ together with a standard Brownian motion $(B_t)_{t \ge 0}$ such that, for some $\sigma > 0$ and some $\lambda < 1/2$,
$$S_n \psi = B_{n \sigma^2} + O(n^\lambda) \quad \text{almost surely as } n \to \infty.$$
artifact.category_tag: Statistical limit laws for Hénon maps
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question in a recent list of open problems on Hénon maps (published 2024). While LCLT and ASIP have been established in broad classes of nonuniformly hyperbolic systems (including some real Hénon-like maps), there is no available result establishing both LCLT and ASIP for equilibrium states $\mu_\phi$ of Hölder potentials of complex Hénon maps for all non-coboundary Hölder observables. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Hénon Maps: A List of Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Published list of open problems on Hénon maps including statistical properties of equilibrium states.
status_evidence.claim: The LCLT and ASIP for equilibrium states of Hölder potentials are listed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Almost Sure Invariance Principle for Nonuniformly Hyperbolic Systems
status_evidence.snippet: ASIP established for general classes of nonuniformly hyperbolic systems including some Hénon-like maps.
status_evidence.claim: Related ASIP results exist but do not cover the full setting of complex Hénon equilibrium states.
